output.summary: C is the strongest overall: accurate, brand-aligned, complete, cautious about claims and actionable without promising uplift. B is a close second, also accurate and well-scoped, but its copy underplays the short-weekend positioning. D is strong on arithmetic and brand voice but has a simulated-review-theme risk and an unsupported ATC uplift target. A has useful calculations and checks but carries the highest factual/claims risk by recommending display of the simulated 120-review count and an unsupported bottle-fit claim.
